newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-EDBERG MAY PLAY DOUBLES IN DAVIS CUP FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EDBERG MAY PLAY DOUBLES IN DAVIS CUP FINAL.

text.p: Stefan Edberg may be forced to play doubles in the Davis Cup final against France this weekend because specialist Jonas Bjorkman has a knee injury, Swedish officials said on Monday.

The officials said Edberg, 30, who retires from international tennis after the final, was certain to play in the singles but could also play in the doubles as Bjorkman was experiencing problems with a recurring knee injury.
